---
title: Theme
description: The @puzzle-ui/theme package owns Puzzle's design tokens, color themes, typography, fonts, and theme scoping.
---

<code>@puzzle-ui/theme</code> is the source of truth for Puzzle's visual design.
It turns a typed token object into CSS custom properties, loads configured
fonts, resolves light and dark color schemes, and lets you scope a theme to the
whole document or a single subtree.

All <code>@puzzle-ui/ui</code> components consume these CSS custom properties, so a single <code>Theme</code> provider styles your application.

## Quick start

Wrap your application in a single <code>Theme</code> at the root. Without any props it applies the default tokens, follows the user's system color scheme, and injects Puzzle's global styles.

```tsx
import { Theme } from "@puzzle-ui/theme";

const App = () => (
  <Theme>
    <YourApp />
  </Theme>
);
```

A customized root theme can combine a color theme, fonts, and token overrides.

```tsx
<Theme
  theme="system"
  colorTheme="cobalt-sky"
  fonts={{
    heading: { family: "Sora" },
    body: { family: "Inter" },
  }}
  tokens={{
    radius: { md: "0.5rem" },
  }}
>
  <YourApp />
</Theme>
```

## What the package provides

| Area                 | Description                                                                                       | Documentation                                  |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Theme provider       | Injects token CSS variables, loads fonts, and applies global styles at root or local scope.       | [Theme Provider](/docs/theme/theme-provider)   |
| Design tokens        | Typed token groups for spacing, radius, shadows, elevation, borders, layout, motion, and z-index. | [Design Tokens](/docs/theme/tokens)            |
| Colors               | Semantic color roles, light/dark color schemes, and built-in color themes.                        | [Colors](/docs/theme/colors)                   |
| Typography and fonts | Named typography roles, fluid font sizes, and Google Font loading.                                | [Typography and Fonts](/docs/theme/typography) |
| Breakpoints          | Shared responsive breakpoints for JavaScript and CSS.                                             | [Breakpoints](/docs/theme/breakpoints)         |
| Component overrides  | Global link and image component overrides for router and framework integration.                   | [Component Overrides](/docs/theme/components)  |

```tsx
  ThemeComponents,

  ThemeLinkComponentConfig,
  ThemeImageComponent,
} from "@puzzle-ui/theme";
```

## How it works

<code>Theme</code> resolves the default tokens, the optional color theme, and
your token overrides into a flat map of CSS custom properties.

It renders a style element that assigns those variables to the document root or to a generated scope attribute. Static CSS shipped with the package maps scheme-specific variables onto semantic variables based on the active mode, including automatic <code>prefers-color-scheme</code> handling in system mode.

Token values are validated before they are written into CSS. Unknown token names and invalid values should be corrected rather than silently ignored.
